name: 1. FC Köln
notes: Member club (e.V. holds pro arm, no investor). Köln fans confronted Nice ultras Sept 2022 (32 injured, UEFA fine and away ban); large DFB pyro fines; FIFA transfer ban 2023 (inducement case, not financial).

name: 1. FC Nürnberg
notes: Member club, no outside investor. Ordinary DFB pyro fines only; club researched and published its 1933 exclusion of Jewish members.

name: AC Milan
notes: RedBird Capital (PE) owns ~99.9%, Toulouse sister club; Elliott vendor loan at holding level. Curva Sud leaders jailed (Doppia Curva, mafia-aggravated crimes), club was injured party. UEFA FFP breach led to 2019-20 Europa League exclusion. Emirates shirt sponsor.

name: AEK Athens
notes: Greek shipping owner Iliopoulos since 2015. UEFA sanctions 2023 and 2025 (pitch invasion, fireworks, partial closure). OPAP betting brand on shirt. Cups = 16 Greek Cups + 1990 League Cup.

name: AFC Wimbledon
notes: Re-founded by supporters in 2002 after Wimbledon FC moved to Milton Keynes; Dons Trust majority owner (minimum stake cut to 50.01% in 2026). Wimbledon FC honours (1988 FA Cup) not counted. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Accrington Stanley
notes: Local owner Andy Holt since 2015. Original club folded 1966, re-formed 1968. Academy closed 2025. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Alavés
notes: Local Baskonia-Alavés group (Querejeta). Iraultza 1921 on Spain's official violent-groups list since 2022. Shirt sponsor is a surrogate brand of an Asian betting operator.

name: Anderlecht
notes: Owner Marc Coucke (Belgian) since 2018. Repeated UEFA crowd sanctions (West Ham 2022, Fenerbahce 2025, Hammarby 2026); domestic sanction for homophobic chant. Napoleon Sports & Casino sponsor; stadium named for state-owned National Lottery. Cups incl. 1 League Cup.

name: Angers
notes: Owned by Chabane family; former owner-president Saïd Chabane convicted 2024 of sexually assaulting six female employees. DNCG transfer and wage restrictions 2025-26.

name: Arsenal
notes: Kroenke Sports & Entertainment full owner since 2018 (also owns Colorado Rapids). Signed Super League 2021, withdrew in two days. Emirates (Dubai state airline) shirt and stadium. Continental = 1994 Cup Winners' Cup + 1970 Fairs Cup.

name: Aston Villa
notes: V Sports (Sawiris, Edens) with US fund Atairos ~32%; V Sports holds 29% of Vitória SC. UEFA squad-cost settlement 2025 and June 2026 fine. UEFA fine for Traveller-community banner at 2026 Europa League final. Betano sleeve, Visit Rwanda chest. Capacity reduced during North Stand rebuild (usually ~42,600). Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: multi_club flagship->none: V Sports' 29% of Vitoria SC is under 30%, no network.

name: Atalanta
notes: Percassi family 45% with US consortium (Pagliuca) 55%; club owns its stadium. 2023 sanction for 'zingaro' chants at Vlahovic; Curva Nord long violent record (leadership banned 2021, 2025 brawl with Como fans).

name: Athletic Club
notes: Member-owned association; Basque-only player policy. UEFA EUR 50,000 fine 2025 (chants, objects, flares v Man United); club expelled Herri Norte promoters. No racism sanction found.

name: Atlanta United
notes: MLS expansion franchise (play from 2017), owner Arthur Blank. League title = 2018 MLS Cup. NFL stadium (full capacity given). No conduct issues found.

name: Atlético Madrid
notes: Apollo Sports Capital (PE) ~55% since Mar 2026. Frente Atlético far-right roots; Vinícius effigy 2023 (four convicted), UEFA racism fine 2024; club issued nine life bans. Derby suspended 2024 for objects thrown; 2014 Frente-linked killing older than 5 years. Riyadh Air (Saudi state) shirt and stadium. Cups incl. 1985 Copa de la Liga.

name: Austin FC
notes: MLS expansion franchise (play from 2021); lead owner Anthony Precourt previously tried to move Columbus Crew to Austin. Every home match sold out. Coach is interim.

name: Auxerre
notes: Majority owned (~60%) by Chinese businessman James Zhou since 2016. No sanctions found.

name: Barcelona
notes: Member-owned. Stayed in Super League until Feb 2026. Two UEFA discrimination sanctions 2024 (Nazi salutes at PSG, 'Flick Heil' banner). LaLiga squad-cost breaches and UEFA 2023 settlement; Negreira referee-payments case. Camp Nou partly reopened (capacity in flux). Continental incl. 3 Fairs Cups; cups incl. 2 Copa de la Liga.

name: Barnet
notes: Long-time owner Anthony Kleanthous moved the club from Underhill (Barnet) to The Hive in Harrow in 2013; plans to return to the borough.

name: Barnsley
notes: Majority owner Neerav Parekh (US-based). FA fine and action plan Dec 2022 for gendered abuse; earlier 2020 fine for sectarian chants. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Bayer Leverkusen
notes: Wholly owned by Bayer AG (works club, 50+1 exemption). DFB EUR 18,000 fine 2024 for discriminatory banner.

name: Bayern Munich
notes: e.V. majority with Adidas, Allianz, Audi minority. Visit Rwanda deal reduced to youth-academy partnership to 2028; Betano official betting partner (not shirt). Cups incl. 6 DFB-Ligapokal. 2025 Boateng internship cancelled after fan protest. Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: sponsor_state 1->0: Visit Rwanda cut to a youth-academy partnership (not shirt, stadium or headline); Qatar Airways ended 2023.

name: Birmingham City
notes: Controlled by Shelby Companies, subsidiary of US investment firm Knighthead Capital; Tom Brady minority. EFL points deduction 2019 (P&S). Coral (betting) shirt sponsor 2026-27. Women's team 97% sold to outside consortium 2026.

name: Birmingham Legion FC
notes: USL Championship franchise (play from 2019) owned by local business group; plays in a 47,100-seat college-football bowl.

name: Blackburn Rovers
notes: Owned since 2010 by India's Venky's (absentee, long-running fan protests). No sanctions found.

name: Blackpool
notes: Owner Simon Sadler (lifelong fan) since 2019; his fund Segantii charged with insider dealing in Hong Kong. FA fine July 2023 for sectarian chanting. Prior Oyston era found to have stripped assets.

name: Bodø/Glimt
notes: Member association, no private owner. No UEFA fan sanctions found. Gaza Red Cross donation 2025; new part-fan-funded 10,000 arena due 2027. Women's side last in Toppserien.

name: Bohemians
notes: Member-owned (one member, one vote); saved by members in 2010-13 crisis. Flare hit a player at St Pat's Feb 2024 (away ban). Refugees Welcome and charity kit campaigns. Cups incl. 3 League Cups.

name: Bologna
notes: Canadian Joey Saputo owner since 2014, also owns CF Montréal. BGame News (betting operator brand) top partner since July 2026, not shirt. Coach Tedesco since June 2026.

name: Bolton Wanderers
notes: Football Ventures rescued club from administration 2019 (12-point deduction 2019-20). Fan bond scheme. No sanctions found.

name: Borussia Dortmund
notes: e.V. controls listed KGaA (50+1). Rheinmetall (arms) Champion Partner despite members' non-binding vote against; bwin betting partner (not shirt). Anti-extremism statutes and Holocaust-remembrance work.

name: Borussia Mönchengladbach
notes: Member-run e.V., no outside investor. No sanctions found.

name: Bournemouth
notes: Black Knight Football Club (Bill Foley) since 2022; hub of network incl. Lorient, Moreirense, Auckland, Hibernian stake. MrQ betting sleeve. 2008 administration (-17 points, over 10 years); supporters' trust ownership after 1997 rescue.

name: Bradford City
notes: German owner Stefan Rupp since 2016; long-running low-price season tickets. No sanctions found. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Brentford
notes: Owner Matthew Benham (lifelong fan) bought club from supporters' trust Bees United in 2012; trust keeps board seat. Hollywoodbets was shirt sponsor to 2025-26, now official betting partner (not shirt).

name: Brest
notes: Local Le Saint family owners. 2024 two-match stand closure after incidents v Strasbourg. No senior women's team found.

name: Brighton
notes: Tony Bloom (local fan, fortune from sports betting) owner since 2009; minority stakes in Union SG, Hearts, Melbourne Victory. Betway official betting partner (not shirt). Club barred Guardian reporters Dec 2025. Sleeve: Experience Kissimmee (US county tourism board). Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: sponsor_state 1->0: Experience Kissimmee sleeve is a county (regional) tourism board.

name: Bristol City
notes: Lansdown family owners since 1996, in talks (Aug 2026) to sell majority to a betting-firm owner. FA fine Aug 2025 for racist chant v Cardiff.

name: Bristol Rovers
notes: Kuwaiti businessman Hussain AlSaeed controlling owner since 2023. Tenants at rugby ground; no sanctions found. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Bromley
notes: Local chairman Robin Stanton-Gleaves. No sanctions found. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Brooklyn FC
notes: New franchise (men from 2026) owned by NY family office North Sixth Group; women's team in USL Super League since 2024.

name: Burnley
notes: ALK Capital (Alan Pace) bought 84% in 2020 with MSD loan secured on the club; owners' Velocity Sports Partners also own Espanyol. No sanctions found.

name: Burton Albion
notes: Nordic Football Group majority since 2024; club accepted 28 FA agent-regulation breaches (sanction pending).

name: CF Montréal
notes: Owner Joey Saputo (also Bologna). Ultras Montreal banned 2021 after assault on Toronto fans; 2023 brawl; antisemitic abuse Aug 2026 (fans banned, section privileges revoked). 2021 rebrand imposed over fan objections. Cups = Canadian Championships. Coach interim.

name: Cagliari
notes: Tommaso Giulini controls; US investors at 49%. Racist abuse from stands 2017-19 and Maignan/Tomori 2022 (no sanction). Shirt sponsor Sardegna Turismo (regional government tourism brand). Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: sponsor_state 1->0: Sardegna Turismo is a regional government brand.

name: Cambridge United
notes: Paul Barry 75%; supporters' company Cambridge Fans United holds a stake with a board seat. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Cardiff City
notes: Malaysian owner Vincent Tan since 2010 (absent 1,000+ days, fan protests). FA fine Apr 2026 for homophobic chanting. Visit Malaysia (government tourism) shirt sponsor. Cups count FA Cup 1927 only (22 Welsh Cups not counted). Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: multi_club none->flagship: Vincent Tan also owns KV Kortrijk (2023 sale collapsed; Wikipedia still lists Tan).

name: Celta Vigo
notes: Mouriño family ~68%. Only routine fan fines found. No betting or state sponsor now.

name: Celtic
notes: Celtic plc, largest shareholder Dermot Desmond (Irish, ~35%). 2026 Ibrox pitch invasion (37 arrests, SFA closed-door tie); 20+ UEFA fines for illicit banners since 2007, sectarian chants. Dafabet shirt sponsor. Cups = Scottish Cups + League Cups.

name: Charleston Battery
notes: Owner Rob Salvatore since 2019; moved from purpose-built stadium to smaller complex 2020. Second-tier titles not counted.

name: Charlotte FC
notes: MLS expansion franchise (play from 2022), owner David Tepper (hedge fund; Panthers). NFL stadium (full capacity given).

name: Charlton Athletic
notes: US consortium Global Football Partners since 2023, exploring sale. London.Bet back-of-shorts and betting partner. Red, White and Black anti-racism work. At The Valley since 1992 return (1985-92 exile). Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: sponsor_betting 1->0: London.Bet is back-of-shorts and official betting partner only, not shirt or main partner.

name: Chelsea
notes: Clearlake Capital (PE) sole control since Sept 2026; BlueCo also owns Strasbourg. FA charge Sept 2026 for sectarian chant (pending), prior chant fines. PL fine Mar 2026 for undisclosed payments, UEFA 2023 settlement. Continental incl. 2025 Conference League.

name: Cheltenham Town
notes: Mike Garlick ~75% since 2025; Robins Trust ~15%. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Chesterfield
notes: Community Trust took over the club in 2020, now partners Kirk family owners; ~1,500 fan and local shareholders. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Chicago Fire FC
notes: Owner Joe Mansueto (also FC Lugano); privately funded stadium under construction. League title = 1998 MLS Cup. Plays at NFL Soldier Field (full capacity given). 2019 rebrand drew fan backlash.

name: Club Brugge
notes: Bart Verhaeghe main shareholder since 2011 (settled Clean Hands case 2022). Antisemitic chanting cases 2021, Nazi salutes 2024, Hitler salute fine 2026; club bans offenders. Betsson shirt sponsor.

name: Colchester United
notes: Owner Robbie Cowling since 2006, trying to sell. Attendance is 2024-25.

name: Colorado Rapids
notes: Kroenke Sports & Entertainment (also Arsenal). League title = 2010 MLS Cup.

name: Colorado Springs Switchbacks FC
notes: USL franchise owned locally by Weidner Apartment Homes, which built the downtown stadium. Second-tier 2024 title not counted.
